spec.name: M7.SignatureTau.binary_monic
spec.guidance: Every nonzero binary polynomial is monic: leadingCoeff_ne_zero and the finite fact ∀c:ZMod2,c≠0→c=1 (decide). No squarefree assumption. Explicitly reduce Monic to leadingCoeff=1. Return tactic lines only without leading by.

spec.name: M7.SignatureTau.gcd_canonical
spec.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N], ∀ p : M6.Cyclic.BinaryPolynomial, (EuclideanDomain.gcd p (M6.Cyclic.modulus N)).Monic ∧ EuclideanDomain.gcd p (M6.Cyclic.modulus N) ∣ (M6.Cyclic.modulus N) ∧ EuclideanDomain.gcd (M6.Cyclic.modulus N) p = EuclideanDomain.gcd p (M6.Cyclic.modulus N)
spec.guidance: Both gcd orders are nonzero because modulus is monic and gcd_eq_zero_iff. Apply binary_monic. Divisibility is gcd_dvd_right. For swapped equality do not assume a generic EuclideanDomain gcd_comm theorem: prove mutual divisibility by dvd_gcd/gcd_dvd_left/right and use monic polynomial antisymmetry, e.g. Polynomial.eq_of_monic_of_dvd_of_natDegree_le. Return tactic lines only without leading by.

spec.name: M7.SignatureTau.tau_properties
spec.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N], ∀ (u : (ZMod N)ˣ) (F : M6.Cyclic.BinaryPolynomial), (M7.SignatureTau.tau u F).Monic ∧ M7.SignatureTau.tau u F ∣ (M6.Cyclic.modulus N)
spec.guidance: Unfold tau and use first two conclusions of gcd_canonical. F may be arbitrary; modulus positive ensures gcd nonzero. Return tactic lines only without leading by.

spec.name: M7.SignatureTau.reduced_image
spec.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N], ∀ (u : (ZMod N)ˣ) (F : M6.Cyclic.BinaryPolynomial), M6.Cyclic.image N (M7.SignatureTau.reduced u F) = M7.QuotientAuto.substitution u (M6.Cyclic.image N F)
spec.guidance: AdjoinRoot.modByMonicHom_mk and AdjoinRoot.mk_leftInverse for the proved monic modulus show remainder has same quotient image. Then apply accepted QuotientAuto.polynomial_substitution. Actual substitution, not arbitrary automorphism. Return tactic lines only without leading by.

spec.name: M7.SignatureTau.tau_principal
spec.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N], ∀ (u : (ZMod N)ˣ) (F : M6.Cyclic.BinaryPolynomial), M7.SignatureIdeal.principal N (M7.SignatureTau.tau u F) = (M7.SignatureIdeal.principal N F).map (M7.QuotientAuto.substitution u)
spec.guidance: Unfold tau and reverse accepted SignatureIdeal.principal_gcd. Ideal.map_span and Set.image_singleton reduce to the actual accepted polynomial_substitution equality. This equality is between actual ideals and keeps every repeated factor. Return tactic lines only without leading by.

spec.name: M7.SignatureTau.source_tau_equal
spec.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N], ∀ (u : (ZMod N)ˣ) (F : M6.Cyclic.BinaryPolynomial), M7.SignatureTau.sourceTau u F = M7.SignatureTau.tau u F
spec.guidance: First use gcd_canonical swapped-order result on reduced u F. Both gcds are monic divisors. Apply SignatureIdeal.monic_injective; principal_gcd identifies the reduced gcd ideal with principal reduced, while reduced_image and polynomial_substitution identify its actual quotient generator with substituted u F. This proves equivalence of the original gcd(M,reduced sigma) algorithm, not a definition change. Return tactic lines only without leading by.

spec.name: M7.SignatureTau.tau_one
spec.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N], ∀ F : M6.Cyclic.BinaryPolynomial, F.Monic → F ∣ (M6.Cyclic.modulus N) → M7.SignatureTau.tau (1 : (ZMod N)ˣ) F = F
spec.guidance: Use monic_injective on monic divisors. Rewrite tau_principal and actual substitution_one, then Ideal.map_id. N=1 remains included; do not replace unit.val1 by1 unconditionally. Return tactic lines only without leading by.

spec.name: M7.SignatureTau.tau_comp
spec.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N], ∀ (u v : (ZMod N)ˣ) (F : M6.Cyclic.BinaryPolynomial), F.Monic → F ∣ (M6.Cyclic.modulus N) → M7.SignatureTau.tau v (M7.SignatureTau.tau u F) = M7.SignatureTau.tau (v*u) F
spec.guidance: Apply monic_injective with tau_properties on both sides. Rewrite tau_principal twice and Ideal.map_map; accepted QuotientAuto.substitution_comp gives the actual composition. No assumed automorphism or root-set argument. Return tactic lines only without leading by.

spec.name: M7.SignatureTau.tau_inverse
spec.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N], ∀ (u : (ZMod N)ˣ) (F : M6.Cyclic.BinaryPolynomial), F.Monic → F ∣ (M6.Cyclic.modulus N) → (M7.SignatureTau.tau (u⁻¹) (M7.SignatureTau.tau u F) = F ∧ M7.SignatureTau.tau u (M7.SignatureTau.tau (u⁻¹) F) = F)
spec.guidance: Apply tau_comp in the two inverse orders, simplify inv_mul_cancel/mul_inv_cancel, then tau_one with original monic-divisor hypotheses. Exact conjunction is parenthesized. Degree invariance is a separate root-owned batch and is not assumed here. Return tactic lines only without leading by.
